about: Every clip slot in the trailer and the deck. See film/CLIP_SLOTS.md. kind: made (we build it), auto (an agent captures it), human (bonus). 'file' is filled when a clip lands; the build reflows timing from it. Capture closed on 9 Oct: every 'file' below is a take or mix in film/clips or film/mixes (paths relative to film/), chosen in film/CLIPS.md, which also covers speed, glitch frames, size and framing. No live or human capture is coming.
